rules.allowed_only: Every Telegram read must pass the current server whitelist.
rules.source_of_truth: Current MCP and HTTP answers are read directly from Telegram at request time.
rules.background_collection: Periodic background collection is disabled in production.
rules.sqlite_role: The existing SQLite database is retained as legacy cache/history and is not the source of truth for new answers.
rules.freshness: Freshness is determined by the live Telegram read performed for the current request.
rules.search: Search is performed on demand across the requested allowed chats and results are merged newest-first.
rules.user_interaction: The user does not choose a technical retrieval mode.
rules.legacy: Yandex Serverless rolling/on-demand GitHub workflows and scheduled snapshot refreshes are retired.
